content:
<#if execution.status == "FAILED">
  {
    "text": "*${tenant}: Crawler Failure Notification*",
    "blocks": [
      {
        "type": "section",
        "text": {
          "type": "mrkdwn",
          "text": "*🚨 ${tenant}: Crawler Failure Notification*"
        }
      },
      {
        "type": "section",
        "fields": [
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Datasource name:* ${assembly.name}"
          },
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Tenant:* ${assembly.tenantId}"
          },
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Status:* ${execution.status}"
          },
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Crawling Type:* ${execution.crawlingType}"
          },
          <#if execution.selectedAssets?has_content>
             {
               "type": "mrkdwn",
               "text": "*Selected Assets:* ${execution.selectedAssets?join(", ")}"
             },
          </#if>
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Started At:* ${acceldata_dateFormat(execution.createdAt)}"
          },
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Finished At:* ${acceldata_dateFormat(execution.updatedAt)}"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "type": "section",
        "text": {
          "type": "mrkdwn",
          "text": "<${link}|🔗 Visit Datasource Page>"
        }
      },
      {
        "type": "section",
        "text": {
          "type": "mrkdwn",
          "text": "*Error Message:*"
        }
      },
      {
        "type": "section",
        "text": {
          "type": "mrkdwn",
          "text": "```${execution.errorMessage}```"
        }
      }
    ]
  }

<#elseif execution.status == "COMPLETED">
  {
    "text": "*${tenant}:Crawler Execution Successful*",
    "blocks": [
      {
        "type": "section",
        "text": {
          "type": "mrkdwn",
          "text": "*✅ ${tenant}: Crawler Execution Successful*"
        }
      },
      {
        "type": "section",
        "fields": [
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Datasource:* ${assembly.name}"
          },
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Tenant:* ${assembly.tenantId}"
          },
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Status:* ${execution.status}"
          },
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Crawling Type:* ${execution.crawlingType}"
          },
          <#if execution.selectedAssets?has_content>
            {
              "type": "mrkdwn",
              "text": "*Selected Assets:* ${execution.selectedAssets?join(", ")}"
            },
          </#if>
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Started At:* ${acceldata_dateFormat(execution.createdAt)}"
          },
          {
            "type": "mrkdwn",
            "text": "*Finished At:* ${acceldata_dateFormat(execution.updatedAt)}"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "type": "section",
        "text": {
          "type": "mrkdwn",
          "text": "<${link}|🔗 Visit Datasource Page>"
        }
      },
      {
        "type": "section",
        "text": {
          "type": "mrkdwn",
          "text": "*📦 Datasource Summary:*\n```\n<#if assetCounters?has_content><#list assetCounters as asset>• ${asset.type}: ${asset.count}\n</#list></#if>```"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
</#if>
